summary.text: Paul Bettencourt, a Republican, represents Texas Senate District 7, covering parts of Montgomery County, western Harris County, West Houston and The Villages, and has served in the Senate since 2015. He chairs the Senate Committee on Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Bettencourt served as Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector from 1998 to 2008.
He was elected to the Texas Senate in 2014 and in 2019 authored and passed Senate Bill 2, the Texas Property Tax Reform and Transparency Act.
He is a Texas A&M University graduate with a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Distribution and is President and CEO of Bettencourt Tax Advisors, LLC.
He served as Chair of the Senate Republican Caucus from 2016 to 2021.
